description:
Internal refurbishment and restoration of the existing Grade II listed property, including the reinstatement of previously removed internal partition walls in their original locations, reinstatement of previously removed toilet facilities, installation of the kitchen on the lower ground floor, and associated plumbing and electrical works.  The lower ground floor is currently in poor condition, with unfinished walls and exposed ceiling structures. 

The proposed works also include the conversion of the existing garden studio into a bedroom, repair of the external timber staircase, and replacement of three modern windows on the lower ground floor with traditional-style windows appropriate to the building’s historic character.

Internal improvements will include new timber flooring, decorative wall panelling, traditional cornices and period-appropriate finishes. All surviving historic architectural features, including original ceiling mouldings, will be retained and protected throughout the refurbishment.
